text: The first orthogonality relation states that for irreducible complex representations $V,W$, the inner product $\langle\chi_V,\chi_W\rangle$ equals:
explanation: Irreducible characters are orthonormal: $\langle\chi_V,\chi_W\rangle=1$ when $V\cong W$ and $0$ otherwise. The $\frac{1}{|G|}$ normalization in $\langle\chi,\psi\rangle=\frac{1}{|G|}\sum_g\chi(g)\overline{\psi(g)}$ is exactly what makes the value $1$ rather than $\dim V$ or $|G|$; and distinct irreducibles are orthogonal, so it is not identically $1$.
